_meta.description: Roadmap data. Edit via scripts/roadmap_cli.py, not by hand. Run its `render` command afterward to update roadmap.html. Fully local, nothing here is ever pushed anywhere.

milestones.name: Foundation
milestones.description: Cargo crate on Rune (pinned dev rev), shared data model, persisted store, sysinfo process snapshots.
milestones.why: Every other milestone builds on the shared types and the live process feed.

milestones.name: Process Manager UI
milestones.description: Rune/rune-kit shell: sidebar, Processes tab with live sortable multi-select table, search, theme and motion.

milestones.name: Kill and Related
milestones.description: Kill, kill tree, kill-all-related with a confirmation dialog listing every process first; respawn guard released on manual launch.
milestones.why: The headline feature over the stock Task Manager.

milestones.name: Groups
milestones.description: Create, rename, delete groups; multi-select add/remove; add/remove all related from the active member; kill group / pause group.
milestones.why: Lets the user act on saved sets in one click.

milestones.name: PauseSwitch
milestones.description: Revertable autostart prevention: StartupApproved entries, service start types, scheduled tasks; originals recorded in the store and restored on toggle-off.
milestones.why: Stops apps from coming back after reboot until the user says so.

milestones.name: Polish and Ship
milestones.description: Admin relaunch, tray icon, release build, README.

milestones.name: Glass theme
milestones.description: Palette-tinted mesh gradient background, liquid/fluted/frosted glass panels and a floating glass tab bar with a spring-animated drop (rune-fx compositor); 6 palettes with official light/dark variants, accent, glass style/strength and animated background in Settings, all persisted.

notes: Kill/related/guard and PauseSwitch autostart (M3, M5) have working interfaces but ship as no-op stubs in this build.
